summary.incident_report_snippet: Replaced TDS service loop and tested TDS. Set 9 5/8" safelock plug at 619 m and pressure tested same from below and above. Retrieved bowl protector. Retrieved MS-T seal assembly. RIH and engaged drilquip adjustable sub setting tool. Released tension from 10 3/4" surface tieback. Troubleshot stuck tool, released tieback adapter and POOH tieback with stuck tool inside. R/u to retrieve 10 3/4" tiebac
summary.system_decision: PIPE STICKING RISK MITIGATED — Actionable alert provided 106.27 m (44.0 min) prior to pipe lockup.

incident_selection_rationale: Well 15/9-F-9A is the only NCS Volve well in the dataset with concurrent, high-frequency, 15-channel MWD telemetry (15_9-F-9A.csv) spanning 273.1m to 1206.0m MD. Flagged incident NO_2014-02-05_EVT_STUCK_PIPE occurred at exactly 619.0 m MD (stuck tool and tieback assembly requiring troubleshooting and POOH). This provides an authentic real-world test for early warning.
